items.difficulty_reason: The counted conclusion is the compatibility of proper pushforward with rational equivalence at source lines 2175-2181, label lemma-proper-pushforward-rational-equivalence, whose proof occupies source lines 2183-2269. The proof reduces a locally finite sum of divisors on integral subspaces to a single summand and then splits into three cases according to the dimension of the image. The dimension-preserving case is disposed of by an alteration lemma, but the case where the image has dimension exactly k requires real work: the pushforward is first seen to be an integer multiple of the image class, then the image is shrunk to a scheme, the generic point is pulled back to a one-dimensional proper cover, that cover is proved to be a scheme through the codimension one criterion for the schematic locus and a limit argument, and only then does the scheme case give vanishing. The counted statement records none of the case distinction.
